Q: This is the last day of 1899. What is the date tomorrow in MM/DD/YYYY?
Options:
(A) 01/01/1900
(B) 01/22/1900
(C) 01/01/1899
(D) 02/06/1900
(E) 01/08/1900
(F) 01/01/1827
A:

trace.content:
The context states that today is the last day of 1899. The last day of any year is December 31st. Therefore, the day following December 31st, 1899, is January 1st, 1900.

Looking at the options:
(A) 01/01/1900 - Matches our calculation.
(B) 01/22/1900 - Incorrect.
(C) 01/01/1899 - Incorrect year.
(D) 02/06/1900 - Incorrect.
(E) 01/08/1900 - Incorrect.
(F) 01/01/1827 - Incorrect year.

The correct date is January 1, 1900.

A: (A)
